entries.5677e16d3946d2f9: The company has formulated the Medium-Term Management Plan 2028 (announced May 12, 2026), a three-year plan as the first phase of its long-term vision “Vision 2035”, which looks ten years ahead. Its basic policies include promoting “stabilization of revenue and maximization of growth opportunities” through restructuring of its business portfolio. It states that it will reorganize its business segments into five: Housing Sales Business, Income-Producing Real Estate Sales Business, Hotel Operation Business, Leasing and Operation Business, and Other Business, and that, in addition to growing the real estate sales business, it will expand the stock-type businesses of hotel operation and leasing and operation to build a foundation for the next stage of growth.
entries.5b3c6ef1b0eaac68: Founded in 1974, the company has expanded its business, supplying newly built condominiums, of which it has supplied more than 100,000 units, as well as newly built detached houses and renovated condominiums, and also developing and regenerating income-producing properties, managing real estate leasing, and developing and operating apartment hotels. The cumulative supply of condominiums surpassed 100,000 units in January 2011.
